from solution import max_length_list


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: max_length_list([[0],[1,3],[5,7],[9,11],[13,15,17]]) == (3,[13,15,17])."""
    assert max_length_list([[0], [1, 3], [5, 7], [9, 11], [13, 15, 17]]) == (3, [13, 15, 17])  # max len = len([13,15,17]) = 3


def test_issue_single_list():
    """Find the list with maximum length when only one list is given."""
    assert max_length_list([[4, 5]]) == (2, [4, 5])  # len([4,5]) = 2


def test_issue_max_at_start():
    """Find the list with maximum length when the longest list is first."""
    assert max_length_list([[1, 2, 3], [4], [5]]) == (3, [1, 2, 3])  # max(3,1,1) = 3


def test_issue_max_in_middle():
    """Find the list with maximum length when the longest list is in the middle."""
    assert max_length_list([[1], [2, 3, 4, 5], [6]]) == (4, [2, 3, 4, 5])  # max(1,4,1) = 4


def test_issue_max_at_end():
    """Find the list with maximum length when the longest list is last."""
    assert max_length_list([[1], [2], [7, 8, 9]]) == (3, [7, 8, 9])  # max(1,1,3) = 3


def test_issue_uses_length_not_value():
    """Find the list with maximum length using length, not lexicographic value."""
    assert max_length_list([[1, 0], [9]]) == (2, [1, 0])  # max(2,1) = 2 so [1,0] wins over [9]


def test_issue_with_empty_sublists():
    """Find the list with maximum length when some entries are empty."""
    assert max_length_list([[], [1], [], [1, 2]]) == (2, [1, 2])  # max(0,1,0,2) = 2


def test_issue_single_empty_sublist():
    """Find the list with maximum length for input [[]]."""
    assert max_length_list([[]]) == (0, [])  # len([]) = 0


def test_contract_return_is_tuple():
    """Return shape (3,[13,15,17]) shows result must be a tuple."""
    result = max_length_list([[0], [1, 2]])  # lengths 1 and 2, max = 2
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)


def test_contract_first_equals_len_second():
    """Return shape (3,[13,15,17]) shows first item is len of second item."""
    result = max_length_list([[0], [1, 2, 3]])  # lengths 1 and 3, max = 3
    assert result[0] == len(result[1])


def test_contract_second_is_input_member():
    """Find the list with maximum length means returned list comes from the input."""
    data = [[0], [1, 2], [3]]  # lengths 1,2,1 so max len = 2
    result = max_length_list(data)
    assert result[1] in data


def test_contract_order_length_then_list():
    """Return shape (3,[13,15,17]) shows order is (length, list)."""
    result = max_length_list([[8], [9, 10]])  # lengths 1 and 2, max = 2
    assert isinstance(result[0], int) and isinstance(result[1], list)
